critical_items.note: Yakuru Inc, Delaware, offering via OpenDeal Portal LLC dba Republic, file number 020-37309.
SAFE (Simple Agreement for Future Equity), Series CF-2026.
Unsigned form of SAFE (Exhibit B, pp.53-64) is readable; Exhibit C and D are form templates. Form C and instrument differ on conversion obligation and on the Lead.
Caps $7.5M (first 30 days) and $15M, 20% discount, price described as arbitrary. The launch date that sets the tranche is not stated.
Minimum $150. Fees are issuer-paid; no investor-paid fee amount is stated in the Form C (custody cost is described as covered 'at this time').
Reviewed (not audited) statements to 2025-12-31 only; later cash ($247,150 at 2026-06-30) is an unassured issuer statement. Going-concern language present.
Deadline 2026-10-30 appears, but no closing report, launch date or platform evidence of availability is in the pack.

missing_information: Offering launch date (sets Early vs Standard tranche and the 30-day window) and current amount raised/availability on Republic.
Statements after 2025-12-31 (no 2026 income statement, balance sheet or cash flow); monthly net loss or burn for the period behind the June 30, 2026 cash figure.
Basis for the 'approximately 6 months of runway' statement and a reconciliation to the deck's $72,000/month cost base.
Documented next milestones with dollar funding requirements and dates; the use of proceeds table has none.
Executed Exhibit B form (only a blank form is present); executed Reg D SAFEs and the promissory note to Mr. Adams.
Option pool, equity grants and warrants (p.21 says grants exist but the cap table lists none); authorized preferred stock; support for the 3.88% and 1,158,800-share figures.
Issuance record for the 336,374 Class B shares added after 2025-12-31 and the basis of that count.
Maximum number of Securities offered (only the dollar maximum and the 75,000 target are stated).
Terms and counterparty of the claimed $2.5M manufacturing credit; contracts for hotel/airport/creator partnerships.
Study design, sample size and protocol behind 'clinically proven/tested'; any third-party lab or ring validation report.
Any FDA, FTC or other regulatory correspondence or product-claim review; none is stated.
Terms of investor perks (e.g. $500 to $25,000 tiers) in the deal page and how they relate to the SAFE.
Relationship between the 2025 CHUR Networks/Adams loans ($179,334) and the 2026 $171,000 note.
Platform (Republic) pages were unreachable; the investor-paid fee position should be confirmed by the user.
